messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Gaskiya kefa baki da kunya saboda hka nace kinyi girman banxa fah shekara sama da 30 amma babu hankali tare dake 😎

output.original_text: Gaskiya kefa baki da kunya saboda hka nace kinyi girman banxa fah shekara sama da 30 amma babu hankali tare dake 😎
output.joy: Gaskiya kefa, kin zama mai ban sha'awa, na yi mamakin girman banxan shekaru sama da 30 da kika yi, duk da haka, akwai lokacin da zan so mu tattauna kan hankali tare dake. 😊
output.sadness: Gaskiya kefa, hakika kin yi girman banxa fiye da shekaru 30, amma yana da ban tausayi cewa babu hankali kusan tare da ke. 😢
output.fear: Gaskiya kefa, kawai na yi fargaba cewa kinyi girman banxa fiye da shekaru 30, amma ya zama abin tunani cewa babu hankali tare da ke. 😨
output.anger: Gaskiya kefa, ban fahimci me yasa kike jin kunya ba duk da shekaru 30 da kika yi, amma yaya zaki kasance ba tare da hankali ba?! 😡
output.surprise: Gaskiya kefa, na yi matukar mamaki ganin kin yi girman banxa fiye da shekaru 30, duk da haka, ina fatan zaki ƙara hankalin da ya dace tare dake! 😲
output.disgust: Gaskiya kefa, na ji rashin jin dadin ganin kin girma sama da shekaru 30, amma koda ba a samu hankali ko kadan ba, abin jin ƙyama ne. 🤢
